intelligence.essence: The messenger must be CONNECTED to all the feeds — Personal and the different feeds — everything as a game of MATCH. Right now it is a placeholder: DM opens a panel that doesn't know who the person is. The fix is a real conversation per person, with their feed and matched content beside it.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you have a magic phone that knows all your friends! When you tap on Sophia, it should open a chat with Sophia — her messages, a box to type in, and all the things you both love, right beside it! But right now, when you tap, it opens an empty room that doesn't even know who Sophia is! That's not a magic phone yet — we have to connect it so every friend opens their very own room!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — the messaging should be connected to everything, dear — your Personal page, all the different feeds — so when you talk to someone, you're talking inside the world you share, with their content right there beside the conversation. But right now, love, when you tap to message Sophia, it opens an empty little panel that doesn't know who she is at all — no messages, no box to write in, nothing. It needs to be a real conversation, dear, with her feed beside it.
